additional_info.subject: bkob1U without connection to the router via SCB
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
For the
bkob1U
charger, the password is still
"admin01"
, even after a successful commissioning. The issue is that we now need to configure the
ELM
service for the project's
DLMS
. To do this, we must modify the configuration of the
XF3 Router
from the
SCB
, setting the
Main WAN Interface
to
Wi-Fi
and enabling the option
Open Ports through VLAN on WAN Port to the PLC
.
This charger was recreated by the support team, and since then we have not been able to access the router configuration through the
SCB
; it does not connect, and the router password is
“OI9sbSVrKHnoUWtETimq”
.
When accessing the
XF3 Router
directly to perform this configuration manually, additional settings were detected. The router was then restored to its default configuration using
SICHARGE D Companion 2.6.0 Factory
. However, after applying the configuration change, the charger no longer initializes and remains stuck on the loading screen at
30%
.
In conclusion, we need to be able to access the routers of the
bkob1U
charger from the
Router Configuration
section in the
SCB
.
Attached are images of the configuration on the XF3 Router.
Best regards,

Hello Lodhar,
According to R&D someone incorrectly comissioned this router, someone
reset the router passwords but only for the ssh user. The user admin had a different password.
Please go to site, do a factory reset on the router and use companion tool to configure the router again.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466968-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP/R7 170002131] Issue Configuring XF3 Router CRM:02889000919
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I performed a factory reset and loaded the configuration on routers XF3 and XF4 using the SICHARGE D Companion. However, after a few minutes, it seems the configuration was replaced, and it does not allow access either with the default password
Admin01
or with the actual one (
OI9sbSVrKHnoUWtETimq
).
On December 22, we replaced the QA21-22 contactors. Since that change, it seems the router configuration is being modified, losing communication with SCB, OCPP, and changing the access password.
I don’t know how or why this happens, but it’s as if they are being automatically configured or continuously receiving a configuration, preventing the default settings from remaining.
Best regards,
Lodhar Aedo L.

According to R&D someone incorrectly comissioned this router, someone reset the router passwords but only for the ssh user. The user admin had a different password.
Please go to site, do a factory reset on the router and use companion tool to configure the router again.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
